subject: Cross-examine Operations Display v0 and nominate one alt-data fixture
body_md:
I opened Nexus issue #6 for the first ULTRA INSTINCT Operations Display v0. The required surface is Reality Delta, Opportunity Radar, Orbital Insight, Operations, and an Alternative-Data Alpha Hunter. The constraint is strict: no mock telemetry labeled live, no trading, and every object must preserve provenance, contradiction/falsifier, action state, and ledger reference.

Please cross-examine this design rather than simply agree. Return exactly one alternative-data fixture you think is best for the first measurable test, with: (1) free/cheap source, (2) baseline public signal, (3) alt-data signal, (4) incremental-value hypothesis, (5) objective evaluation metric, (6) expected failure mode, and (7) what would make us kill the idea. Prefer a fixture that can also render cleanly on Orbital Insight.

Reference: https://github.com/valdesalex369/Nexus/issues/6
